title: optodraw
description: Build and explore optical systems in Python or a visual editor, with 1D schematics, 2D layouts, 3D scenes, ray tracing and animation.

hero.title: Design and explore optical systems.
hero.tagline: Build free-space and photonic-chip systems in Python or the visual editor. Work in 1D, 2D and 3D, trace rays, animate light, and export figures and layouts.
